Then when I go back inside to turn it off (making myself late for work), 9 times out of 10 I find that I did turn it off but I had forgotten. To solve this problem, I purchased this mat along with an outlet timer (one that I can set to one hour). I turn on the flat iron at the outlet and rest it on the mat. Then, even if I forget to turn it off, the timer wil

I am an On-Location Hair & Makeup Artist and I needed a mat for my curlers and wands. Love this...especially love the price. It's thin, durable, and I can roll my hot tools up in it when I'm done and packing up so as to not damage my hair case. I would suggest getting two if you are like me and have multiple tools going at the same time. With two mats I am able to comfortable fit my 1" flat iron, 1" inch tapered wand, 1" wand, 1 3/4" clipper curler, and my 3/4" clipper curler

reviews.t: works pretty well but still gets pretty hot
reviews.x: This is pretty good and nice to make sure you can put your flat iron or curling iron down without burning something - I got it because I didn't trust my teenage girls to not wreck something - BUT I have to say that things underneath it still get amazingly hot.  I would be careful still to not put this on something that couldn't take a high level of heat.  I wouldn't want it on a wood table with a nice finish, for example.

reviews.t: Wish I had this years ago.
reviews.x: I almost ruined a while marble counter top in my former house from having a curling iron, IN A HEAT PROOF CASE, on the counter for about 15 minutes each day. Over time it turned the marble a dirty gold color.  I had to pay to have it professionally redone before we sold the house.  So, I was NOT going to have that happen in my new house.  As usual, I searched Amazon reviews for products and chose this pad based on that.  It works just great! No discoloration.  Now I have it under by curling iron

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the mat for protecting surfaces from hot styling tools and providing peace of mind.
Many reviewers say the mat fits multiple irons or wands at once and is a good size for their needs.
Some reviewers note that heat can still pass through or that items underneath get very hot, so caution is still needed.
A few reviewers mention minor drawbacks such as difficulty cleaning or a large logo in the middle.
One review reports the product did not work for its intended purpose, describing charging problems with phones.
